About Us

Built Canadian.
Flavoured Tex-Mex.

"We don't cut corners. Our flavour does the talking — rich, smoky, textured, and built with intention."

GUAC Mexi Grill was born from a simple belief: Canadian-built quality and bold Tex-Mex flavour can share the same plate. Real ingredients, made in-house, cooked with fire.
